decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposal, by reason of its scale, depth and proximity to neighbouring properties, represents and overly dominant and intrusive form of development, which would result in significant harm to the living conditions of the neighbouring properties through loss of daylight, a loss of outlook, and an increased sense of enclosure and over shadowing, harmful to neighbour's living conditions. The proposal is therefore contrary to adopted Local Plan Policies CC2 (Urban Design and Architecture), SC7 (Residential Extensions and Alterations) and the intent of the Residential Extensions Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed development, by reason of its size and scale represents a bulky, obtrusive and incongruous addition resulting in harm to the character and appearance of the property and the wider area. It is therefore not considered to comply with adopted Local Plan Policies CC1 (Context and Character), CC2 (Urban Design and Architecture), SC7 (Residential Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines SPD.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house
